decoded.meaning: ERROR{ VALUE u16=0x0031 (tr::schema::not_found) } — the reply the golden core builds for a write or a read of `:settings.delivery_mode`, a name with no wire spelling
decoded.note: the per-vertex delivery_mode (RFC-0008 §C) is owner-side state set by vertex_policy_t::delivery_mode; the vertex :settings core namespace is empty (RFC-0022 §3.B), so the name resolves to nothing. Byte-identical to settings/removed-knob: the ERROR identity carries no name detail.
